summary: Cardiol Therapeutics Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq and TSX, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 9, 2026 news release announcing participation in a fireside chat at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference on September 14, 2026 at 10:30 a.m. EDT at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; the filing is a routine investor-conference notice with a webcast link, plus boilerplate drug-pipeline and forward-looking statements. No special-situation event; watch only for pipeline updates on CardiolRx Phase III MAVERIC and CRD-38.
